keywords: 以验证者为主导的公共物品资金机制
隐私与后量子成为必选项
summary: 周日较安静。clesaege 在 ethresear.ch 发表 Validator Redirected Revenue，提出两项协议层改动，让验证者自行配置把一定比例的质押奖励转给公共物品，以解决以太坊共享改进中的搭便车问题，讨论热度很高。Eli Ben-Sasson 就 EF 风波发表看法。

items.topic: 协议层的公共物品资金
items.title: ethresear.ch：Validator Redirected Revenue
items.note: 15:34（clesaege）。文章认为以太坊陷入协调失败：所有人都从共享改进中受益，但没人愿意在别人可以搭便车时付钱，造成持续的无谓损失。提案在协议层引入两项改动，建立由验证者驱动的资金机制，验证者配置把一定比例的质押奖励转出。
items.note_en: 15:34 (clesaege). The post argues Ethereum is stuck in a coordination failure: everyone benefits from shared improvements but no one wants to pay when others can free-ride, creating a persistent deadweight loss. It proposes two protocol-level changes for a validator-driven funding mechanism, where validators configure a percentage of staking rewards to be redirected.

items.note: 19:12，他不加入抨击 EF 的一方，也不认为一切都好，以太坊有很多优势，也有其政治。

keywords_en: a validator-driven public goods funding mechanism
summary_en: A quiet Sunday. clesaege published Validator Redirected Revenue on ethresear.ch, proposing two protocol-level changes that let validators configure a share of their staking rewards to be redirected to public goods, to address free-riding on Ethereum's shared improvements; the thread drew a lot of discussion. Eli Ben-Sasson shared his view on the EF turmoil.
